children: Canada apparel retailer's Q2 revenue grew 44% yr/yr, beating analyst expectations
Adjusted EPS for Q2 beat analyst expectations
Company attributes growth to strong demand for Summer and Fall collections and digital channel
Aritzia sees Q3 net revenue between C$1.275 bln and C$1.325 bln
Aritzia forecasts FY27 net revenue of C$4.78 bln to C$4.88 bln
Company expects FY27 adjusted gross margin to rise 225-275 bps from 44.9% in FY26
PRODUCT DEMAND - Co said high demand for Summer and Fall collections drove Q2 results
DIGITAL CHANNEL - Co said digital channel net revenue grew 68% in Q2, driven by robust demand and new mobile app
MARGIN IMPROVEMENTS - Co said adjusted gross margin rose due to IMU improvements, occupancy leverage and improved markdowns
The current average analyst rating on the shares is "buy" and the breakdown of recommendations is 13 "strong buy" or "buy", 2 "hold" and no "sell" or "strong sell"
The average consensus recommendation for the apparel & accessories retailers peer group is "buy"
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for Aritzia Inc. is C$189.00, about 53.3% above its October 7 closing price of C$123.28
The stock recently traded at 22 times the next 12-month earnings vs. a P/E of 31 three months ago
